entries.title: Hearts of Iron
entries.definitive_edition: Hearts of Iron Platinum on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2002 grand-strategy game.

primary.version: Hearts of Iron Platinum / Windows PC release
primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best-documented route for the original Hearts of Iron and its Platinum content, with better compatibility and capture options than the historic Mac port.
primary.how_to_play: Play a preserved Windows PC/Platinum release with modern compatibility fixes as needed. Later Hearts of Iron sequels are separate entries rather than replacements for the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Platinum is an expanded package for the original game, not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Hearts of Iron II
entries.definitive_edition: Hearts of Iron II Complete on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2005 grand-strategy game.

primary.why: Hearts of Iron II Complete on Windows PC bundles the base game with Doomsday and Armageddon, making it the cleanest complete route. The Mac port is valid, but Windows PC has the clearest current storefront, compatibility, and capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play Hearts of Iron II Complete on Windows PC through Steam or GOG for the bundled base game, Doomsday, and Armageddon content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Doomsday and Armageddon are bundled expansion content in the Complete package here. Arsenal of Democracy and Darkest Hour are standalone Hearts of Iron games and are listed separately.

entries.title: Hearts of Iron III
entries.definitive_edition: Hearts of Iron III Complete/Collection on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes if needed.

primary.version: Hearts of Iron III Collection / Complete
primary.why: The Windows PC complete/collection route bundles the base game with its major expansions and has the clearest current storefront, compatibility, and capture support. The Mac port is valid but not the best current recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play Hearts of Iron III Collection or Complete on Windows PC through Steam or GOG to get the major expansion content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Semper Fi, For the Motherland, and Their Finest Hour are expansion content rather than separate mainline entries.

entries.title: Arsenal of Democracy: A Hearts of Iron Game
entries.definitive_edition: Arsenal of Democracy: A Hearts of Iron Game on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Arsenal of Democracy is a Windows PC standalone Hearts of Iron game, so Windows PC is both the only sourced route and the definitive way to play it.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arsenal of Democracy on Windows PC through Steam or GOG.

entries.remaster_caveats: Arsenal of Democracy is a standalone Hearts of Iron game based on Hearts of Iron II technology, not DLC for Hearts of Iron II Complete.

entries.title: Darkest Hour: A Hearts of Iron Game
entries.definitive_edition: Darkest Hour: A Hearts of Iron Game on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Darkest Hour is a Windows PC standalone Hearts of Iron game, making Windows PC the only sourced release route and definitive way to play it.
primary.how_to_play: Play Darkest Hour on Windows PC through Steam or GOG.

entries.remaster_caveats: Darkest Hour is a standalone Hearts of Iron game, not a Hearts of Iron II DLC pack.

entries.title: Hearts of Iron IV
entries.definitive_edition: Hearts of Iron IV on Windows PC with current DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC library
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and best Hearts of Iron IV route, with the full DLC library, mod support, keyboard-and-mouse controls, and the cleanest capture/settings path. macOS and Linux are valid native routes, but Windows PC remains the safest complete recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Paradox, Microsoft Store, or GOG, and add the DLC packs you want for the complete current HOI4 content path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Hearts of Iron IV's expansions and country packs are DLC, not separate game entries.
